Apple TV has a packed slate of new shows with star-studded casts, and another one is about to join the lineup. Small Prophets is a British comedy that premieres next week and has already earned a perfect 100% score on Rotten Tomatoes. Here's a trailer for you to watch.

Small Prophets will premiere on Apple TV on October 7 and has already been beloved by audiences and critics alike.

Last month, Apple TV did something quite rare: it acquired the streaming rights to an existing series from another network.

British comedy Small Prophets was a breakout hit when it premiered in the UK earlier this year, becoming a sensation on the BBC and earning a perfect 100% score on Rotten Tomatoes. Now Apple is bringing the beloved series to audiences worldwide.

Small Prophets will premiere on Apple TV on Wednesday, October 7, with the first two episodes, followed by one new episode each week until November 4.

Apple released the trailer for Small Prophets today so you can get an early look. Here's the synopsis, followed by the trailer:

Small Prophets is created, written and directed by Mackenzie Crook, who is also the creator of Detectorists and has appeared in The Office (UK) and Pirates of the Caribbean.

Note: Small Prophets will be available globally on Apple TV, but UK viewers will have to wait until 2027 to see it.

Current comedies airing on Apple TV include Brothers starring Matthew McConaughey, as well as the fourth season of Ted Lasso. The popular Owen Wilson series Stick is also set to return.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month and is also available at a discount through the Apple One bundle.
